estimators.ratio: rho(e, W) = T(e, W, held) / T(e, W, update), paired within a round, T being updates per second over one window's own elapsed time; kappa(e, W) = rho(e, W) / rho(e, 1) of the same round; each the mean over rounds with a one-sample BCa 95% interval
estimators.columns: throughput cells: the mean of one arm's windows of updates/s with a BCa 95% interval, and their median; rho and kappa cells: the mean of the per-round ratios, which is not the quotient of the two arms' means
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.order: within a round the engines run (map, str, bytes) rotated left by round mod 3; within an engine the thread counts follow row `round` of the four-level Williams design; within an (engine, threads) pair the two arms run back to back, update first in even rounds and held first in odd rounds; one bench process per window

gate.rule: per engine at 8 threads: COST when rho_ci_lower >= 1 + margin, NO_COST when rho_ci_upper < 1 + margin, OPEN otherwise; contention label from kappa at 8 threads: GROWS when its lower bound > 1, SHRINKS when its upper bound < 1, FLAT otherwise
gate.scope: this run only; section 39.4 reads a pair of runs: an engine's pair verdict is the run verdict when both runs agree and OPEN otherwise, and #1417's falsifier is met when all three engines read NO_COST in the pair
